lines.line: Aero has a home on the web.
Scroll down through the sky, and each part of the game plays beside you.
The title screen is a sea of ones and zeros.
Copies of you merge into one.
A glass path runs past places you may have forgotten.
The climb goes up above the clouds.
At the bottom, sitting on the clouds, is the game itself.
